products.name: 8LIEN AETHER 3
products.summary: Sub-1kg climbing wheelset. The lightest build in the AETHER range.
benefits: Gen 4 carbon spokes, 2g each, for stiffness without the weight
UCI certified, tubeless ready, 25mm internal width

description.p: AETHER is 8LIEN's carbon-spoke wheel platform: four builds on one design, from a sub-1kg climber to a deep aero build. T1100 and M40X carbon, UCI certified.

Gen 4 carbon spokes weigh 2g each and deliver a stiffness-to-weight ratio steel or alloy can't match. Carbon doesn't accumulate fatigue over thousands of kilometres, and the blade-thin spokes cut drag at speed.
T1100 carbon handles toughness across conditions while M40X reinforces the spoke holes and rim walls for sharp acceleration and cornering. Tested to 90 joules, more than double the UCI standard.

products.name: 8LIEN L3W
products.summary: The lightest L-series build. Shallow depth for pure climbing.
benefits: 45T star ratchet hub and TPI ceramic bearings

description.p: The L-series is built for riders who want more tyre, more grip and more control without giving up speed. Coating-free raw carbon with a wide 25mm internal width.
No paint, no lacquer. The raw carbon finish saves weight and gives each wheelset an honest, industrial look.
A 45T star ratchet hub gives instant power transfer with near-zero dead band, and TPI ceramic bearings lower rolling resistance.

products.name: 8LIEN AERO X8
products.summary: 950g full-carbon disc rear wheel for the bike leg.
benefits: 950g full disc rear wheel, sold as a single wheel
T1000 carbon, the highest grade in commercial production
No spoke drag: one of the highest-return aero upgrades for TT and triathlon
TPI ceramic bearings for lower rolling resistance

description.p: A full-carbon disc rear wheel built for sustained speed, from T1 to the finish line.
A full disc eliminates spoke drag entirely, and disc wheels become more efficient the faster you ride. At typical triathlon pace of 35–45 km/h the Aero X8 is in its element.
